manifest_row.title: Interior Dept. Finalizes Plan to Open Arctic Refuge to Oil and Gas Companies

screening.main_topic: The Trump administration’s plan to open part of the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge to oil and gas drilling, and the resulting legal, economic, and environmental dispute.
screening.climate_relevance: The article reports opponents’ claims that drilling would worsen global warming, harm wildlife already affected by climate change, and that the administration’s review understated greenhouse-gas impacts. It also describes the agency’s argument that emissions would be limited because the oil would displace production elsewhere.
screening.reason: Climate change is a meaningful part of the debate over drilling, but the article is mainly about the refuge lease plan and its broader environmental, legal, and economic consequences rather than climate change itself.
